column1: # Every test class that boots its own Postgres (nexus-0ty8z, step 1).
# A class is a caller of PgContainerHelper.startEmptyDatabase / startDedicated / newContainer, or a
# class that was moved onto a template clone and must stay there (call=clone).
# Columns: class <TAB> call <TAB> kind <TAB> reason.  DbStartClassificationGateTest enforces the table
# both ways: an unlisted caller fails, a stale row fails. A class whose subject is NOT the walk or a
# cluster-level fact has no kind here; it takes a clone (PgContainerHelper.start() or startMigratedByOwner()).

column4: migrates to just before catalog-044-1, seeds the pre-fix owner shape, applies the rest and reads the repair back
walks to before vectors-068-1 to seed rows and asserts the expand changesets rewrite none of them, then walks fully for the CHECK semantics, the queue guards, the rollback and the walk forward again

walks to before vectors-068-1 to seed a blank-model_version tombstone, then walks fully and asserts the superseded_by CHECK waits (CONTINUE) while the tombstone is unstamped and lands on the next boot once it is filled

the shared walk of the Rdr229P31Sql*DualWriteIntegrationTest classes: seeds before vectors-068, refusals with 068 applied and 069 not, then fully for the ids (quarantine, trigger and taxonomy and catalog groups)
holds the catalog and ring group through the shared walk, then rolls back to a tag and walks forward again, and scans the live function bodies on a second full walk
builds the pre-003 service_tokens shape by hand, then applies only service-tokens-003 and asserts the backfill
stages vectors-004 against a seeded per-dimension pre-state and asserts the unify
chains vectors-004, taxonomy-007 and vectors-005 over a seeded pre-state and calls every repointed object
stages taxonomy-007 against seeded per-dimension centroids and asserts the unify
walks to before taxonomy-014, seeds the pre-repoint foreign keys, applies it and asserts the repoint
stops the walk before vectors-004-1: catalog-025 reads the per-dimension chunk tables the unify drops
proves migration-002 drops migration_jobs, against a walk that excludes the drop and one that includes it
walks to before hygiene-001-1, seeds legacy rows in two tenants, asserts the FORCE-RLS-toggled backfill as a NOBYPASSRLS owner
builds a pre-hygiene-001-5 schema with the test-scope stop tool, seeds legacy and 32-byte chunks, then runs the real walk
walks to before hygiene-002-1, seeds every branch, asserts the backfill and the constraints it adds
walks to before hygiene-004-1, seeds misclassified rows, asserts the re-file
walks to before hygiene-005-3, seeds the shipped defect's shape, asserts the correction
walks to before hygiene-006-1, seeds lagging sequences, asserts the catch-up
walks to before hygiene-007-1, seeds drifted doc_count, asserts the recount
walks to before hygiene-008-1, produces the misregistration with the old function body, asserts the correction
walks to before aspects-004, seeds a legacy row, asserts the FORCE-RLS-toggled backfill stamps it as a NOBYPASSRLS owner
walks to before pipeline-002-1, seeds the pipeline-001 shape, asserts the re-key and the rollback
its two empty-database cases need the state between catalog-036 and hygiene-002-1, and a populated pre-existing row
rolls the tuples changesets back and reapplies them, walks from empty, and cleans legacy oversized rows

walks to before tuples-012-1, seeds ledger rows, look-alikes and delivery and claim-log rows in two tenants, applies it, and asserts the purge as a NOBYPASSRLS owner, FORCE RLS restored, and a second run that deletes only a new ledger row

walks to before aspects-005-2 as a NOBYPASSRLS owner, seeds a queue row as superuser, and asserts the guarded drop on an empty table, a populated table (kept, boot continues, retried) and a throwing guard, plus the rollback shape

walks to before aspects-005-2 as a NOBYPASSRLS owner, seeds queue rows of two tenants as superuser, lets the migration keep the table, and asserts the engine-start drain's moves, dead-letters, retained rows and the next boot's drop

walks to before collections-001-2 as a NOBYPASSRLS owner, seeds registry rows and a data_moves row as superuser, and asserts the gated index waits (move absent, open, failed, duplicate), is skipped unrecorded, then applies on the boot both conditions hold; and the unscoped duplicate counter under FORCE RLS
walks to before staging-003, sets up one shape per test (aged rows, foreign grants, non-owner), finishes the walk and asserts the drop
runs vectors-030-1 as production does over a seeded pre-walk layout and asserts the partitioned result, its failure and resume paths
walks to before vectors-036-1 over a seeded pre-walk layout, applies the drop alone, rolls it back and compares the retired tables' catalog shape
rolls the walk back to a tag and re-walks, asserting what each rollback leaves
rolls vectors-057-1 back alone on a two-role walk and compares every nexus function with a database walked to its predecessor
rolls vectors-058-1 and vectors-058-2 back on a two-role walk and compares every nexus function with a database walked to vectors-057
walks the old engine's changelog tree, injects divergence or legacy rows, then upgrades to HEAD
the migrator's own contract: aged-box walks as a non-superuser owner, outcome counts, journal, locks
the migrator's lock-capacity preflight and the walk's own lock count, both only while vectors-030-1 is still pending
starts a cluster with a lowered max_locks_per_transaction and max_connections (postmaster settings) and walks the largest tenant count the lock preflight admits
the migrator's disk preflight, which fires only while vectors-030-1 is still pending
creates the nexus_diag role itself (declared exclusive) and connects as it to prove the grants a full walk gives it
replays taxonomy-011-1 against a pre-existing foreign-owned view, a state only a database before the walk can hold
replays the GH 1402 crash loop: an owner walks from scratch, then a superuser-owned view meets the grants changeset
a non-superuser owner walks the changelog twice, so the runAlways service-grant loop and the default privileges both meet nexus.data_moves, which must stay without a nexus_svc grant

walks the changelog as it stood before nexus.data_moves (a derived old grants-nexus-svc-1 text), then boots the current one on that database and asserts the registry and the absence of a nexus_svc grant
walks the schema as each of several migrator roles (nexus_svc, a superuser, a BYPASSRLS login) and asserts vectors-029's precondition
grants role membership edges on nexus_svc, which would leak into every later class on a shared cluster

migrates as nexus_svc itself (the single-role posture: vectors-065 owner-read skip names that role), which the shared cluster already holds from the template migration and cannot drop; role state is cluster-wide
a hand-made RLS harness with no product schema; pins that /version reports a missing public.databasechangelog, so the database must be unmigrated
builds a minimal public.databasechangelog-shaped table itself; a migrated database already has the real one
tests acquireEmptyDatabase itself: isolation, exclusive roles, cleanup
falsifies grants-004 without the migrator's pg_monitor admin option; on a shared cluster nexus_svc already holds pg_monitor (role membership is cluster-wide)
reads the plans auto_explain writes to the container's server log, and sets auto_explain on a cluster-wide role
reads auto_explain plans from the container's server log, which a shared cluster fills with every class's output
tests the server-log reader against containers whose log it controls
builds the container recipe unstarted to pin its wait strategy, and starts one whose wait must fail to read the log tail it prints
a latency measurement that creates and drops about 2,500 leaves; wants an idle server and a lock table of its own
outgrows the default tmpfs; needs a 3g tmpfs and 4g container
outgrows the default tmpfs; needs a 3g tmpfs and 4g container
outgrows the default tmpfs; needs a 4g tmpfs and 6g container
outgrows the default tmpfs; needs an 8g tmpfs and 12g container (70k rows of 1024 dimensions under two HNSW indexes)
outgrows the default tmpfs; needs a 6g tmpfs and 10g container (220,000 chunks of 384 dimensions under an HNSW index, a trigram and a full-text index)
attaches the Postgres container to a Docker network shared with a PgBouncer container
builds its own container from a different image (plpgsql_check)
tests the DDL counter's switch on the container factory's own output (tmpfs, server log, probe)
tests the DDL counter's switch on a dedicated container (its server log goes to Docker when the counter is off)
tests the DDL counter's switch on an empty database (the probe is installed only when the counter is on)

tests the container factory's own tmpfs and memory bounds
tests that the factory returns the fail-fast container
asserts the state the walk leaves and later boots; the walk is the owner-migrated template's (nexus-0ty8z)
tests the vectors-030 objects on scratch parents, as the owner; the walk is the template's (nexus-0ty8z)

tests the PCI reconciler as the owner on a migrated store; the walk is the template's (nexus-0ty8z)
reads leaf statistics and reloptions of a migrated store as the owner and a service role; the walk is the template's (nexus-dxsjc)
injects drift by owner DDL on a migrated store and re-runs migrate; the first walk is the template's (nexus-0ty8z)
needs a completed first walk, then drives the lock cases; a template clone is that walk (nexus-0ty8z)

migrates to just before catalog-047-1, asserts the column, index, audit table and chunk_sensitive functions are absent, applies them, rolls the three changesets back and reapplies them

creates the nexus_diag role itself (declared exclusive) and reads the ACL of leaves and model partitions made after a full walk
migrates to just before note-uri-001-1, seeds notes and planted twins, asserts the guard aborts changing nothing, then applies it and reads the rewrite back

migrates to just before note-uri-001-1, seeds a legacy note, its aspect and highlight, an export row and a code residue row, applies the backfill, then drives the register, import and rename routes over HTTP; a control variant marks the backfill run without executing it
migrates to just before vectors-054-1, asserts the ring table and the upsert function are absent, applies them, rolls both changesets back and reapplies

walks to before telemetry-019-1 as a NOBYPASSRLS owner and asserts the guard against a foreign-owned view, the same-walk re-point of an owned five-leg view, and the rollback shape of the dropped table against the shape read before the drop
starts a cluster with ssl=on (a postmaster setting) so export pages read over TLS, the cloud path whose closed-socket end of stream the plain-TCP shared cluster never shows (nexus-csayy.9)
boots the image with pg_background built at the bundle pin and asserts the extension, a worker and pgvector in it
boots the pg_background image, migrates as a non-superuser admin and walks the library install scenarios: absent extension, missing role, failing changelog, single role, stale lock

the base of DataMoveWorkerIntegrationTest and DataMoveWorkerBehaviourIntegrationTest: boots the pg_background image once per class and runs the data-move worker's passes over real dml_utils runs (100k rows, kill and resume, FORCE RLS tenants, per-leaf runs, bloat, roles after registration, slots; row-security modes, pause, supersede, stop, orphans, the failure and finisher seams)

the single-role posture of the owner-read pattern: migrated by nexus_svc as the one role, the policy changeset must be MARK_RAN and the registering one must still run, which needs a database that nexus_svc owns and the pg_background image
